source: https://arxiv.org/html/2106.09685v2 (Sections 1, 4.1-4.2, 5.5, 7.1-7.2, 8, Appendix F.3, H.2; Tables 4, 5, 16, 18) incl. Figure 1 image used by the post
sampling: 27 body blocks (prose paragraphs, list items, tables, image line; headings, display math, rule and references excluded) numbered from L16; started at block 1 and took every second block (L16, L22, L28→L30, L34, L38, L42, L48, L54, L58, L71, L80, L86), then added L16's throughput claim and a second L80 number to reach 15 claims, 8 of them numbers. The whole post was read for wrong claims outside the sample.

A: L56 '전체 미세조정 기준선과 이 방법들을 한 표에 정리했습니다' describes the post, not the paper (edit residue the run's own review left). Front matter, math delimiters and heading levels are otherwise clean.
B: L34 '결국 갱신 크기를 조절하는 학습률과 비슷한 역할을 합니다' → '갱신 크기를 조절한다는 점에서 학습률과 비슷하게 작동합니다' (결국 + 역할을 하다).
L22 '더 큰 문제는 이런 방법들이 미세조정 기준선에 못 미치는 경우가 많다는 데 있습니다' → '게다가 이런 방법들은 미세조정 기준선에 못 미칠 때가 많습니다' (noun frame).
L54 '앞서 소개한 전체 파라미터를 모두 학습하는 전체 미세조정' → '전체 미세조정' (redundant re-definition).
C: L69 '앞서 구현 방식에서 본 대로 ... W_q와 W_v를 함께 적응하는 쪽이 WikiSQL에서 더 높았습니다' breaks the main-results paragraph with a Table 5 point the reader already has from L46.
L56 names four baselines that were never introduced, so the 'PrefixEmbed는 ... 63.1에 머물렀고' contrast in L69 lands without context.
D: BitFit, 어댑터 H, PrefixEmbed, PrefixLayer (L56) are named but never explained, and WikiSQL, MNLI-m and SAMSum are never introduced. A non-expert can't read the main table (L58-67) without that.
L84 'subspace similarity' is used without saying what is compared (column spaces of A for r=8 vs r=64), even though it is the paper's key analysis.
E: Table 4 (L58-67) and Table 16 (L73-78) are verbatim and well placed. The rank-allocation result (Table 5, L46) is given as two prose numbers, where a short table row would show the 18M trade-off better. Minor.
F: L34 '$$\frac{\alpha}{r}$$은 $$\Delta Wx$$ 전체의 크기를 바꾸므로, 결국 갱신 크기를 조절하는 학습률과 비슷한 역할을 합니다' is the writer's own mechanism and is not marked as such. The paper says only that tuning α is roughly the same as tuning the learning rate. No wrong numbers: Table 4 and Table 16 match cell for cell.

U1: Coverage (U1): the post reports only GPT-3 175B. RoBERTa/DeBERTa on GLUE and GPT-2 on E2E are never mentioned, and neither is the memory/storage saving the paper calls 'the most significant benefit' (Sec 4.2: training VRAM 1.2TB → 350GB, checkpoint 350GB → 35MB at r=4 on W_q,W_v). Nothing in L44-50 or L84 covers it.
U2: L16 TL;DR is five sentences carrying six numbers, not the two to three lines asked for. It also headlines the 18M ablation (73.7 vs 73.8, Table 5) instead of a Table 4 row, and never says LoRA 4.7M beats full fine-tuning on MNLI-m and SAMSum (L69).
Repeated numbers inflate length: 32.5/43.1/25% at L16 and L50; 18M/73.7 at L8, L16 and L46.

claim_headings.evidence: Fixed summary headings are topic names (L18 '## 연구 배경', L26 '## 제안 방법', L44 '## 구현 방식', L52 '## 실험 결과', L82 '## 의의와 한계'), but each section opens with a one-line thesis (L20, L28, L46, L54).

running_example.evidence: GPT-3 175B and WikiSQL thread through TL;DR (L16), rank allocation (L46) and main table (L58-69); the only worked numeric example is a hypothetical 12,288-dim matrix (L38) that is not tied back to the 18M budget.

mechanism_choice_formula_example.evidence: Problem (L22) → design choice vs adapters/prefix (L40-42) → formula h=W0x+BAx (L32) → numeric example 98,304 vs ~1억 5,100만 (L38).

facts_once.evidence: 18M/73.7 appears in description (L8), TL;DR (L16) and L46; 32.5/43.1/25% in L16 and L50; the W_q vs W_q+W_v finding is restated at L69 ('앞서 구현 방식에서 본 대로 ... W_q와 W_v를 함께 적응하는 쪽이 WikiSQL에서 더 높았습니다'); latency/sequence-length limits of adapters/prefix at L16, L22, L40.

numbers_with_scope.evidence: Most numbers carry model, metric and setting (L46 '96개 층', L69 '4.7M 파라미터를 쓴 LoRA'); but M counts are not converted in prose (L16 '파라미터 175,255.8M개', L69 '4.7M', '37.7M'), and L16 pairs a throughput rise 32.5→43.1 (+33%) with '약 25% 빨랐습니다' without saying 25% is the paper's speedup figure.

nothing_invented.evidence: No invented numbers or tables; Table 4 and Table 16 match cell for cell. One unlabelled causal explanation at L34 ('α/r은 ΔWx 전체의 크기를 바꾸므로, 결국 ... 학습률과 비슷한 역할을 합니다') goes beyond the paper; L38 example is labelled '가상의 예'.

writer_assessment_end.evidence: L92 '이 글의 판단으로는 ...' gives a deployment decision (merge vs not, check r and target matrices for far domains), though it leans on the paper's own batching limitation.

length_fit.evidence: About 6,100 body characters, five sections, two tables; fits a short method paper summary.

type_shape.evidence: Five fixed summary sections and one distilled main-results table (L58-67), but the TL;DR (L16) is a five-sentence paragraph rather than two to three lines.

korean_style.evidence: Consistent 입니다 register; residual patterns: '결국' (L22, L34), '역할을 합니다' (L34), noun frame '못 미치는 경우가 많다는 데 있습니다' (L22), meta sentence '한 표에 정리했습니다' (L56), redundant '앞서 소개한 전체 파라미터를 모두 학습하는 전체 미세조정' (L54).

extras.main_results_note: Table 4 (GPT-3 175B main results) is reproduced at L58-67 with all 8 rows and every cell matching the paper (params, WikiSQL, MNLI-m, SAMSum R1/R2/RL), and L69 interprets it correctly (4.7M LoRA above FT on MNLI-m and SAMSum, WikiSQL 73.4 vs 73.8 within ±0.5, 37.7M at 74.0). top_issues: L8/L16: TL;DR and description headline the Table 5 ablation (18M, W_q+W_v r=4, WikiSQL 73.7) rather than the Table 4 main results, and omit that LoRA 4.7M beats full fine-tuning on MNLI-m (91.7 vs 89.5) and SAMSum. The TL;DR is also five sentences long, and L16 writes '파라미터 175,255.8M개' without converting the M unit.

Coverage (U1): the post reports only GPT-3 175B. RoBERTa/DeBERTa on GLUE and GPT-2 on E2E are never mentioned, and neither is the memory/storage saving the paper calls 'the most significant benefit' (Sec 4.2: training VRAM 1.2TB → 350GB, checkpoint 350GB → 35MB at r=4 on W_q,W_v). Nothing in L44-50 or L84 covers it.

L34: unlabelled, unsupported mechanism for α/r ('ΔWx 전체의 크기를 바꾸므로 ... 학습률과 비슷한 역할'). L56: a meta sentence, and the baselines are named but never defined. L69: restates the L46 W_q/W_v finding inside the main-results discussion.
